description.fun: A Donphan rebuilt as a machine, with a face screen that flashes angry red eyes and tyre-like armour that lets it curl up and roll like a wheel. A paranormal magazine suggested it was a weapon built with technology not of this world. When it sleeps it switches itself off, curls into its wheel and lets the red glow on its treads go dark.
description.guide: A Ground and Steel-type Paradox Pokémon found in Pokémon Violet, said to be either a future relative of Donphan or a version of it from a parallel timeline. It curls up and rolls like a wheel to attack. Its ancient counterpart is Great Tusk.
description.tagline: A robot Donphan that rolls like a wheel and sleeps switched off
